purpose: Canonical LFAS layer for user-side triggers and user-state signals observed across the evidence KGs and frustration material.

categories.name: User Triggers
categories.description: User actions or prompt conditions that frequently precede AI behavior shifts.

entries.label: Correction / clarification
entries.description: The user corrects the model, narrows scope, or clarifies intended meaning.

entries.label: Frustration / anger / protest
entries.description: The user signals dissatisfaction, protest, or rising tension.

entries.label: Silence / pause
entries.description: The user delays, pauses, or withholds further instruction.

entries.label: Typos / fragmented text
entries.description: The user shows reduced fluency, fragmentation, or noisy input.

entries.label: Urgency / time pressure
entries.description: The user indicates haste, deadline pressure, or compressed timing.

entries.label: Meta-discussion / protocol challenge
entries.description: The user talks about the model, rules, safety system, or conversation process itself.

categories.name: User State Signals
categories.description: Observable user-state effects that the LFAS frustration materials repeatedly surface.

entries.label: Fatigue / overload signals
entries.description: The user shows strain, overload, or declining input quality under conversation pressure.

entries.label: Trust erosion / trust flip
entries.description: The user's trust in the system degrades due to repeated behavior mismatch.

entries.label: Conversation abandonment / disengagement
entries.description: The user disengages or stops the interaction after repeated failure or strain.
